info.title: quiva.ai Microsoft 365 API
info.description: Outlook mail connection, mail filing into space folders, and mail automations. All routes act on the caller's own mailbox unless marked admin. The `/m365/rules` routes were withdrawn. Files and SharePoint sync routes are not part of this spec.

tags.description: Filing mail from a mailbox into space folders

get.description: Admin only. The Microsoft URL an organisation's admin opens to approve the Mail app for the tenant.
Public. Microsoft redirects the admin here after approving or declining. Account binding comes from the single-use `state`, not a session. Answers `ok: false` with an error and detail on any failure.

parameters.description: Single-use state from the consent URL

parameters.description: Error code when approval was declined

post.description: Links the caller's mailbox to a folder. Matching mail is saved there as .eml files. For an automation (`kind: automation`) an action runs on each filed message. 409 when the caller already has a filter on this folder. 403 when the caller has no mailbox connected.

oauth2.description: API integration client credentials. Tokens only work on the task-sync routes in workspaces.

admin_consent_required.description: True when the organisation's Microsoft 365 tenant has not approved the Mail app yet

sync_now.description: Poll the mailbox now instead of at the next interval. This also advances a filing's history import. A paused mailbox stays paused.

connect_url.description: Microsoft sign-in URL to open for the user

FilingAction.description: An automation's action, run once per message it files.

type.description: `agent` asks Abbie with `prompt`, `flow` starts the flow at `flow_subject` with the filed copy, `notification` tells `user_ids`.

MailFiling.description: A mail filter or an automation. Matching messages from the owner's mailbox are saved into `folder` as .eml files, and an automation then runs its action on each.

kind.description: A record with no kind is a filter

folder.description: Space-relative dot path the files land in

entity_folder.description: Contact or organisation folder the filter was set up from

attachments.description: Also save attachments beside the copy

run_on_import.description: Whether the action also runs for imported history. Off by default.

stopped.description: Why a filter paused by itself

CreateMailFilingRequest.description: The caller must have a connected mailbox and the match must name at least one address, domain or subject word.

folder.description: The folder or its parent must exist

backfill_since.description: Start a history import from this date. At most 90 days back.

backfill_expected.description: The matching count the preview showed, for progress

PatchMailFilingRequest.description: Omitted fields are left alone. The match, attachments, `then` and `backfill` belong to the mailbox owner. `folder`, `paused` and `use_my_mailbox` are also an admin's on anyone's filing.

backfill.description: True restarts the history import over the full window. Messages already filed are not filed twice.

use_my_mailbox.description: Move a stopped or someone else's filing onto the caller's own mailbox

AutomationRun.description: One action run on one filed message
